applicability: Sanity-checking a claimed ITD against the rigid-sphere far-field low-frequency approximation for a single azimuth

equations.effective_azimuth: fold azimuth into 0..90 degrees using front-back and left-right symmetry of a sphere

assumptions: far-field plane-wave incidence on a rigid sphere
head modeled as a sphere; pinna, torso and individual head shape excluded
uncertainty: Cross-checked at theta=90 degrees against the commonly cited ~650-660 microsecond human maximum ITD (655.8 microseconds at a=8.75cm, c=343 m/s); not fitted to that value, it falls out of the formula directly.
limits_policy: Explicit caller-declared error tolerance, not a presumed standard.
